title: Sunrise
summary: Random dots for stars, a sun on the horizon, and a ground that hides what sits under it. The picture at the top of this site.
teaches: a theme that follows the page

title: One circle
summary: The smallest useful spec: one accent circle on the light theme.

title: Scatter with a trend line
summary: Twelve points and a guide line. Shows the scatter element and a line in muted ink.

title: Seeded random field
summary: 900 dots placed by a seed. Change the seed and the dots move; the frame does not.

title: Bar chart
summary: Six bars on a baseline, drawn as rectangles from a top-left corner and a size.

title: Dark poster
summary: The same vocabulary on the dark theme. Only the colour tokens change, not the layout.

title: Line chart over a grid
summary: Three guide lines in the grid token and one accent series on top.

title: Controls
summary: A sunrise with sliders, a select and a toggle. The seed, the theme, the star count and the sun size all follow controls.
teaches: seed and theme from a control

title: Bar chart from data
summary: Six months of revenue in a data table. The axes, the scales and the ticks come from the numbers, not hand-placed coordinates.

title: Log scale with a legend
summary: Visits against time on a log x axis, with points, a path and a legend. Shows the log scale and the zero-free linear axis.
